items.question: Under which Cabinet Resolution number was the rewards and incentives system for UAE federal government employees approved?
items.fact: Federal employee rewards system approved by Cabinet Resolution 42/2024

items.question: What are the three types of rewards and incentives under the UAE federal government employee rewards system?
items.gold: Annual Performance Rewards, Outstanding Achievement Rewards, and Contribution to any National Achievement Rewards.
items.fact: Three reward types for federal employees: performance, achievement, national
